preconditions.description: Attacker must be an approved spender of victim's tokens
Victim must have sufficient token balance to be exploited
Victim must call approve() to change existing approval while attacker monitors

exploit_hint: 1. Attacker obtains initial approval from victim for X tokens. 2. Monitor victim's approve() transactions via mempool. 3. When victim attempts to change approval from X to Y, immediately call transferFrom() with the old approval amount X before the new approval transaction is confirmed. 4. After victim's new approval is confirmed, call transferFrom() again with the new approval Y. 5. This allows attacker to spend X+Y tokens instead of just Y, exploiting the race condition in the approve function that doesn't check previous allowance.
